title: AAPS treatment -> xDrip sync config
body:
Hey guys,
I struggle to get all my treatments from AAPS to xDrip. Until now I was using Nightscout (at fly.io) for exchanging the bgs, treatments etc between AAPS and xDrip. I wanted to get rid of this and do it via local broadcast. But I struggle to set it up correctly.
I searched the documentations and different discussions (e.g. https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/discussions/2636) but even then it is not working.

My setup:
- xDrip Nightly 2123120516
- Libre 3
- Juggluco (enabled xdrip broadcast and patched broadcast)
- AndroidAPS 3.2.0.2 (getting BGs directly from Juggluco now)
- *AAPS: enabled broadcast to xDrip+

*I also saw the hint here to enable "xDrip+ Sync Follower" as main source in xDrip. This is fine for me, but what is the master in this way? I tried localhost or 127.0.0.1 , but no luck. Nothing is received.
In xDrip I have enabled "local broadcast"+ "Accept Glucose" + "Accept treatments". I also played a bit with different settings for "identify receiver" ...
Can anyone support me to set this correctly? I really tried lots of configurations...
Any ideas?

My goal is pretty simple: I want to get rid of the necessity to have nightscout in fly.io to exchange all treatments between AAPS and XDrip, especially when both apps are running on my mobilephone :)

PS: I also raised similar topic at xDrip team: https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/discussions/3247

comments.body:
I fixed it finally :)

Today I realized in xDrip I see all the treatments like intended. I switched off the setting "Local Broadcast" in xDrip and I think this did the trick.

so my final working setup:
- xDrip Nightly 2123120516 
1.  disable local broadcast
2. enable "accept treatment" and "accept glucose"
3. Data source: Libre patched
- Libre 3
- Juggluco (enabled xdrip broadcast and patched broadcast)
- AndroidAPS 3.2.0.2 (getting BGs directly from Juggluco now)
